scripts.build:ifstale: set -eu && if [ -f dist/.build.stamp ] && [ -z "$(find src assets package.json pnpm-lock.yaml tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json app.json app.config.ts -newer dist/.build.stamp -type f ! -name '*.test.ts' ! -name '*.test.tsx' ! -name '*.snap' -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo '👌 dist is fresh, build skipped'; else npm run build && touch dist/.build.stamp; fi
scripts.test:acceptance:locally: set -eu && npm run build:ifstale && LOCALLY=true jest -c ./jest.acceptance.config.ts --forceExit --verbose --runInBand --passWithNoTests $([ "${RESNAP:-}" = "true" ] && echo '--updateSnapshot')
scripts.test: set -eu && npm run test:commits && npm run test:types && npm run test:format && npm run test:lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:acceptance:locally
scripts.test:acceptance: set -eu && npm run build && jest -c ./jest.acceptance.config.ts --forceExit --verbose --runInBand --passWithNoTests $([ -n "${CI:-}" ] && echo '--ci') $([ "${RESNAP:-}" = "true" ] && echo '--updateSnapshot')
